title: Skill Eagle Strike
wikitext:
A [[Monk]] special attack. Eagle Strike is trainable at level 20, where it replaces [[Tiger Claw]] as the Monk special punch attack. It is superseded by [[Dragon Punch]] / [[Tail Rake]] at level 25.

Eagle Strike has a reuse time (cooldown) of 6 seconds. Max damage at level 20 is 16.
